name: Himari
source: The crown princess to Grand Yakumo, a medieval style kingdom 1000 years in the future. She is responsible for waking Akira with a kiss and she gives him many kisses to keep him awake and as a reward to help her find out the secret of the ruins he was discovered in. As the crown princess she is expected to marry royalty because her child will be next in line for the throne.
